decisions.rationale: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma is a distinct clinical entity that does not match the provided diagnostic findings.
Secondary CNS involvement by systemic diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is not supported by the absence of lymphoma cells in the bone marrow and the specific CNS involvement pattern.
Lymphomatosis cerebri variant of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is a subtype of PCNSL, but the provided information does not specifically support this diagnosis over PCNSL.
